g.title: Solenoid coil
g.desc: Bobbin-wound solenoid coil, vertical axis. Orange (+) and purple (-) terminals on the left.

g.title: ADS1115 breakout, breadboard view
g.desc: Flat breadboard-view part drawn to the footprint of the board it replaces: two pad columns of six at 43.4 unit pitch. Right column is ALRT ADDR SCL SDA GND VDD top to bottom; left column carries the analog inputs. Pads are addressable as ads-padL-1..6 and ads-padR-1..6.

g.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
